content.value: A URL is a human-readable route to web resources. DNS translates domain names to addresses so users do not need raw server IPs. Deployment exposes your built files in a way that a browser can request them from the internet. In class projects, treat deployment as part of development, not the final optional step.

concepts.name: URL
concepts.description: A web address that identifies the location and access method for a resource.

concepts.name: Domain name
concepts.description: A human-readable name that maps to an internet address through DNS.

concepts.name: DNS lookup
concepts.description: The process of resolving a domain name to the IP address of a server.

concepts.name: IP address
concepts.description: A numeric network address used to locate a device or server on the internet.

concepts.name: Hosting
concepts.description: Providing server infrastructure where a website or application can be accessed by users.

concepts.name: Deployment
concepts.description: Publishing code or files to an environment where users can access the application.

concepts.name: Static site
concepts.description: A website served as prebuilt files without server-side rendering for each request.

concepts.name: Production environment
concepts.description: The live environment where real users access a website or application.
